# ssf-transmitter

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from servlets/ssf/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/ssf-transmitter.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `ssf-transmitter` component of `servlets/ssf`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.ssf`: generated from its catalogue, [ssf-transmitter.json](../../servlets/ssf/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/ssf-transmitter.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_SSF_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `SSF`, `SSF_RECEIVER` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_SSF_ISSUER` (init-param `issuer`, then system property `oidf.ssf.issuer`, then env `OIDF_SSF_ISSUER`) | Unset | The transmitter's issuer: the SETs' iss and the base of every endpoint it advertises, so the external base receivers use; unset, SSF is off (unless OIDF_SSF_ENABLED=true) and PingFederate starts regardless | **Doesn't start**: Unset: SSF is off (DISABLED). With OIDF_SSF_ENABLED=true it is FAILED_CONFIG, with an ERROR naming this setting | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_SIGNING_ALGORITHM` (init-param `signingAlgorithm`, then system property `oidf.ssf.signingAlgorithm`, then env `OIDF_SSF_SIGNING_ALGORITHM`) | `RS256`; one of `RS256`, `PS256` | How the transmitter signs its SETs | **Doesn't start**: Anything but RS256 or PS256 (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_BASE_PATH` (init-param `basePath`, then system property `oidf.ssf.basePath`, then env `OIDF_SSF_BASE_PATH`) | `/ssf` | The path after the issuer in the endpoints the transmitter advertises; the servlets serve /ssf whatever it says | **Not checked**: Anything but /ssf advertises endpoints nothing serves | Any | No |
| `OIDF_SSF_DATA_STORE_ID` (init-param `dataStoreId`, then system property `oidf.ssf.dataStoreId`, then env `OIDF_SSF_DATA_STORE_ID`) | Unset | A PingFederate JDBC data store, on PostgreSQL, whose pool the SSF store uses; with neither this nor a JDBC URL the store is in memory, lost at a restart and seen by one node only, which production allows only with the in-memory-state risk accepted | **Doesn't start**: An unknown id, or its database down: SSF is FAILED_DEPENDENCY, its endpoints answer 503, and the supervisor starts it again (a wait of up to 5 s doubling to 300 s), with an ERROR each time naming the cause. A database that is not PostgreSQL is refused in production (REFUSED) | Any | No |
| `OIDF_SSF_STORE_DIALECT` (init-param `storeDialect`, then system property `oidf.ssf.storeDialect`, then env `OIDF_SSF_STORE_DIALECT`) | `tables`; one of `tables`, `ldm` | The SSF store's layout: tables, its own three ssf_ tables, or ldm, the Identity Object Model's entry store; only read with a data store or a JDBC URL | **Doesn't start**: Anything but tables or ldm (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting | Any | No |
| `OIDF_SSF_JDBC_URL` (init-param `jdbcUrl`, then system property `oidf.ssf.jdbcUrl`, then env `OIDF_SSF_JDBC_URL`) | Unset | A direct database for the SSF store, for development; wins over the data store. jdbc:h2: and jdbc:hsqldb: are refused, and in production anything but jdbc:postgresql: | **Doesn't start**: A database that cannot be opened: SSF is FAILED_DEPENDENCY, its endpoints answer 503, and the supervisor starts it again (a wait of up to 5 s doubling to 300 s), with an ERROR each time naming the cause; the ERROR shows <jdbcUrl> for the URL. A URL that is not jdbc:postgresql: is refused in production (REFUSED) | Not in production: any value | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_JDBC_USERNAME` (init-param `jdbcUsername`, then system property `oidf.ssf.jdbcUsername`, then env `OIDF_SSF_JDBC_USERNAME`) | Unset | The user for the direct database | **Doesn't start**: As the JDBC URL, the store does not open: SSF is FAILED_DEPENDENCY, its endpoints answer 503, and the supervisor starts it again (a wait of up to 5 s doubling to 300 s), with an ERROR each time naming the cause | Any | No |
| `OIDF_SSF_JDBC_PASSWORD` (init-param `jdbcPassword`, then system property `oidf.ssf.jdbcPassword`, then env `OIDF_SSF_JDBC_PASSWORD`) | Unset; a secret, never shown | The password for the direct database | **Doesn't start**: As the JDBC URL, the store does not open: SSF is FAILED_DEPENDENCY, its endpoints answer 503, and the supervisor starts it again (a wait of up to 5 s doubling to 300 s), with an ERROR each time naming the cause | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_ENABLED` (init-param `kafkaEnabled`, then system property `oidf.ssf.kafkaEnabled`, then env `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_ENABLED`) | `false` | Whether every SET is also published to Kafka; off, no Kafka class is loaded | **Doesn't start**: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it; true without the bootstrap servers is FAILED_CONFIG too | Any | No |
| `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS` (init-param `kafkaBootstrapServers`, then system property `oidf.ssf.kafkaBootstrapServers`, then env `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS`) | Unset | The Kafka brokers, host:port comma-separated; required with Kafka on | **Doesn't start**: Unset with Kafka on: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting | Any | No |
| `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_TOPIC` (init-param `kafkaTopic`, then system property `oidf.ssf.kafkaTopic`, then env `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_TOPIC`) | `sse-events` | The Kafka topic SETs are published to | **Not checked**: Passed to Kafka as it is | Any | No |
| `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL` (init-param `kafkaSecurityProtocol`, then system property `oidf.ssf.kafkaSecurityProtocol`, then env `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL`) | `PLAINTEXT` | Kafka's security.protocol; PLAINTEXT, the default, is the value PR-2 forbids in production | **Not checked**: Passed to Kafka as it is | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SASL_MECHANISM` (init-param `kafkaSaslMechanism`, then system property `oidf.ssf.kafkaSaslMechanism`, then env `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SASL_MECHANISM`) | Unset | Kafka's sasl.mechanism when the protocol is a SASL one; PLAIN when unset | **Not checked**: Passed to Kafka as it is | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SASL_USERNAME` (init-param `kafkaSaslUsername`, then system property `oidf.ssf.kafkaSaslUsername`, then env `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SASL_USERNAME`) | Unset | The SASL user for Kafka | **Not checked**: Passed to Kafka as it is | Any | No |
| `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SASL_PASSWORD` (init-param `kafkaSaslPassword`, then system property `oidf.ssf.kafkaSaslPassword`, then env `OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SASL_PASSWORD`) | Unset; a secret, never shown | The SASL password for Kafka | **Not checked**: Passed to Kafka as it is | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_PUSH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS` (init-param `pushRetryMaxAttempts`, then system property `oidf.ssf.pushRetryMaxAttempts`, then env `OIDF_SSF_PUSH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS`) | `5`; a whole number | How many failed pushes of one SET a push stream takes before it is paused as dead-lettered; 1 or less pauses it on the first failed push | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting | Any | No |
| `OIDF_SSF_PUSH_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS` (init-param `pushRetryBackoffSeconds`, then system property `oidf.ssf.pushRetryBackoffSeconds`, then env `OIDF_SSF_PUSH_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS`) | `5`; a whole number | The background loop's tick, and the base of the push retry's doubling backoff; below 1 means 1 | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting | Any | No |
| `OIDF_SSF_POLL_MAX_EVENTS` (init-param `pollMaxEvents`, then system property `oidf.ssf.pollMaxEvents`, then env `OIDF_SSF_POLL_MAX_EVENTS`) | `100`; a whole number | The most SETs a poll answers when the receiver asks for no number, and the most the receiver's own poll asks for (100 when this is 0 or less) | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting | Any | No |
| `OIDF_SSF_SET_TTL_SECONDS` (init-param `setTtlSeconds`, then system property `oidf.ssf.setTtlSeconds`, then env `OIDF_SSF_SET_TTL_SECONDS`) | `604800`; a whole number | How long an undelivered SET is kept before it is deleted; 0 or less keeps it for ever | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting | Any | No |
| `OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_SCOPE` (init-param `receiverScope`, then system property `oidf.ssf.receiverScope`, then env `OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_SCOPE`) | `ssf.manage` | The scope a bearer token needs for the stream management API and the poll | **Per request**: A scope no client holds: every call is a 403 | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_UNOWNED_STREAM_OWNER` (init-param `unownedStreamOwner`, then system property `oidf.ssf.unownedStreamOwner`, then env `OIDF_SSF_UNOWNED_STREAM_OWNER`) | Unset | The one client admitted to streams that record no owner; unset, nobody is | **Not checked**: An id that names no client admits nobody | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_PROVISIONER_SCOPE` (init-param `provisionerScope`, then system property `oidf.ssf.provisionerScope`, then env `OIDF_SSF_PROVISIONER_SCOPE`) | Unset | The scope that admits a client to the SCIM endpoint and events:emit; unset, nobody is. Never the receiver scope | **Doesn't start**: The receiver scope: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming both settings | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_ALLOWED_AUDIENCES` (init-param `allowedAudiences`, then system property `oidf.ssf.allowedAudiences`, then env `OIDF_SSF_ALLOWED_AUDIENCES`) | Unset | The aud values a client may name when it creates a stream besides its own id, as clientA=aud1,aud2;clientB=aud3 | **Doesn't start**: An entry that is not clientId=aud[,aud]: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_ENDPOINT` (init-param `introspectionEndpoint`, then system property `oidf.ssf.introspectionEndpoint`, then env `OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_ENDPOINT`) | Unset; an http or https URL | Where receivers' and provisioners' bearer tokens are introspected (RFC 7662), through platform's TokenIntrospector: 1 s to connect, 2.5 s in all, and no answer is a 503; <issuer>/as/introspect.oauth2 when unset. An active answer is also held to its exp and nbf, to aud containing OIDF_SSF_ISSUER when it carries an aud, and to carrying a client_id; a token bound to a key or certificate (cnf) is refused, because the SSF endpoints take bearer tokens only | **Doesn't start**: Not an http or https URL with a host: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. A URL that is not an introspection endpoint: every authenticated call is a 503 | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_ID` (init-param `introspectionClientId`, then system property `oidf.ssf.introspectionClientId`, then env `OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_ID`) | Unset | The client that introspects receivers' tokens; unset, no receiver can authenticate | **Per request**: Wrong: every authenticated call is a 503 | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_SECRET` (init-param `introspectionClientSecret`, then system property `oidf.ssf.introspectionClientSecret`, then env `OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_SECRET`) | Unset; a secret, never shown | The introspecting client's secret | **Per request**: Wrong: every authenticated call is a 503 | Any | Yes |

The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it | Not in production: `true` | Yes |

| `OIDF_SSF_VERIFICATION_EVENT_ENABLED` (init-param `verificationEventEnabled`, then system property `oidf.ssf.verificationEventEnabled`, then env `OIDF_SSF_VERIFICATION_EVENT_ENABLED`) | `true` | Whether a receiver may ask for a verification event | **Doesn't start**: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it | Any | No |

The wrong JWKS: every SET is refused | Any | Yes |
| `OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_AUDIENCE` (init-param `receiverAudience`, then system property `oidf.ssf.receiverAudience`, then env `OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_AUDIENCE`) | Unset | The aud an inbound SET must carry; required with the receiver on | **Doesn't start**: Unset with the receiver on: SSF_RECEIVER is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoint answers 503, with an ERROR naming it | Any | Yes |
